summary: ICL Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the pricing of a private offering of $800 million aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes due 2036, bearing interest at 6.036% paid semi-annually, issued at 100% of par. The offering is expected to settle on June 16, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including repaying outstanding borrowings under its revolving credit facility. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction with no special-situation event, as it involves ordinary refinancing and no control change, acquisition, or restructuring. The filing is purely a debt issuance update.
